text:
Rowena Li: sharing a new mock for variant priority and undo affordance in the rollout timeline. main asks: name consistency (rollback vs revert vs undo), keyboard focus order for actions, and concise SR announcements when scrubbing. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/example/variant-priority
Carlos Mendes: looks solid. naming nit: keep menu item as 'Rollback' (short) but modal title should read 'Confirm revert to previous version' and primary button 'Revert'. legal liked explicit 'revert'.
Ivy Zhang: agree on wording. also want an explicit 'Roll forward' label when applicable. avoid 'promote' since ambiguous. Context menu should show 'Rollback' and 'Roll forward' where relevant; disable the latter when no future checkpoint.
Rowena Li: keyboard nav note: make each checkpoint a single focusable element. pressing Enter opens the context menu; arrow keys navigate menu items. ensure focus returns to checkpoint after modal close.
PM Bot: backend constraint reminder: traffic allocation only accepts integer percentages. UI must prevent decimals and show helper text: 'Use whole percentages only.'
Ivy Zhang: accessibility for scrubber: emit short aria-live phrases, e.g., 'History: Apr 15, 2026  staged 10% to Variant A (canary)'; include state token in parentheses. also add visually-hidden status icons per checkpoint (rolled back / rollforward available).
Carlos Mendes: undo banner: after rollback/rollforward show transient banner 'Reverted to v2.5  Undo' with 30s timer. Undo must be keyboard-focusable and announced with role='status'. keep timer visible as text (e.g., 'Undo (30s)').
Rowena Li: microinteraction: avoid making the banner steal focus unless triggered by keyboard shortcut. SR users should get an aria-live announcement but not focus trap.
PreviewBot: preview deployed for branch 'variant-priority' at sha ffe123  https://preview.redwood.dev/variant-priority
Ivy Zhang: small copy tweak: in action menu show short verbs, but in modals add a one-line explanation. e.g., menu: 'Rollback', modal body: 'This will make v2.5 live for all traffic. Audit note (optional):'.
Carlos Mendes: spacing/visual nit: ensure touch targets >=44px at widths under 360px; compact pills should collapse to letter + short label (e.g., 'A 6 Canary') to save horizontal space.
Rowena Li: great feedback, I'll update frames and push changes. will ping when preview is updated.
